name: BUD
description: BUD (Bots Up Display) puts your Grok Bots on your G2: see which bots need you, read their replies, and speak a message to any bot with a long press. Approvals stay in the Grok Bot app. Needs your own BUD relay and a pairing code from your bot.
author: cmdlabtech

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends your messages to your own BUD relay and loads bot replies and the items that need you.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records a short voice message while you hold or tap to talk. The audio goes to your relay to be turned into text, and the relay does not keep it.
